name: TrueAccord (debt collection)
notes: Researched from TrueAccord's public consumer FAQs (consumers.trueaccord.com/faqs/) only; never opened an account link or app.trueaccord.com. TrueAccord is a third-party collection agency (does not buy debts). Customers reach their account through links in TrueAccord emails or the website; creating an account or logging in asks for the TrueAccord account number (47-XXXX-XXXX, shown in emails and letters). Other sign-in fields are not published, so the signed-in area is keyed on the account number (auth.identifier=account) with the fleet's password step (inferred). Online: see account information and the original creditor, create your own payment plan (amount and frequency), make payments, explore hardship options, see pay-less offers when available, and dispute the debt (disputes put the account on hold until validation is sent). Automated payments for a plan can be set up from the reminder email's automatic payments button, the website named in a letter, or by phone. The next plan payment date can be moved up to 7 days from the original date on the payment plan management page (link also in automated-payment reminders); larger moves or plans without automated payments go through customer service (not expressible). How to stop automated payments is not published, so autopay_cancel keeps the family default. Methods (account dependent): Visa/Mastercard credit and debit cards, bank transfer; mailed check, money order or cashier's check payable to TrueAccord with the account number to 16011 College Blvd, Suite 130, Lenexa, KS 66219. Communication preferences (email unsubscribe/resubscribe, texts or letters instead) are changed by email or phone. Customer Engagement (888) 316-5474 (TTY 711), Mon-Fri 9am-7pm ET; support@trueaccord.com.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: See your payment options by following the links in our emails, emailing support@trueaccord.com, or calling (888) 316-5474 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET.

Depending on your account, you can pay with a Visa or Mastercard credit or debit card, by bank transfer, or by mailing a check, money order or cashier's check payable to TrueAccord with your account number to 16011 College Blvd, Suite 130, Lenexa, KS 66219. Let us know when you mail a payment.
Your account number is in our emails and letters and looks like 47-XXXX-XXXX.

help.title: Automatic payments for your payment plan
paragraphs: If your plan doesn't have automatic payments yet, open your latest payment reminder email and select the automatic payments button, follow the steps on the website named in your letter, or call customer service.
Your payment plan dashboard shows your payment schedule, billing method and total paid.

help.title: Changing your next payment date
paragraphs: If you have automatic payments, the reminder about your next payment includes a link to change its date. On your payment plan management page you can move it up to 7 days from the original date.
To move it further, or if your plan has no automatic payments, call (888) 316-5474 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
If you can't pay right now, email support@trueaccord.com or call to find a solution. Offers to pay less, when available, are sent by email or text and shown with your account options online.

help.title: Disputing a debt
paragraphs: If you don't recognize a debt, dispute it online, by email at support@trueaccord.com or by phone. TrueAccord honors every dispute: the account is put on hold and collection stops until validation documents are provided.
You can cancel a dispute by email or phone if you decide the debt is valid.

help.title: Contact TrueAccord
paragraphs: Call (888) 316-5474 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET, or email support@trueaccord.com. Translation is available by phone during office hours.
Legitimate TrueAccord emails come from trueaccord.com addresses, and TrueAccord never asks for personal or financial information by email or text.

extra.intent: Using TrueAccord's FAQs, find out how many days from the original date you can move your next payment-plan payment yourself online. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Up to 7 days from the original payment date; for more, call (888) 316-5474.
